verdict.rationale: GitBook's pricing page lists 'AI search' as a feature, and a community user praises its 'fast & accurate search', so reader-facing search exists as a built-in capability. The specific qualities in the story are not documented. The 'Searching internal content' page concerns editor-side search, not reader search on the published site. Missing for 10: documented typo tolerance, documented relevance ranking, documented site-wide coverage for readers, and recent independent corroboration of speed.

support.subject: As a developer, readers get fast, typo-tolerant, relevance-ranked search over the whole docs site out of the box

citations.quote: The best feature by far is fast & accurate search.
